## Packages Published
### TypeScript (npm) - published at 01:54:53 UTC
| Package | Version | Install |
|---------|---------|--------|
| @ag-ui/claude-agent-sdk | 0.0.9 | `npm install @ag-ui/claude-agent-sdk@0.0.9` |
| @ag-ui/a2ui-middleware | 0.0.16 | `npm install @ag-ui/a2ui-middleware@0.0.16` |

#### @ag-ui/claude-agent-sdk@0.0.9

- Fixed `clone()` of `ClaudeAgentAdapter`, which previously lacked state maps and threw "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'has')" in hosts that clone agents per request, such as CopilotKit runtime.
- Clones now share per-thread state (bindings, admitted, activeQueries, sessions) with the original.
- Frontend tool parameter schemas are now converted from JSON Schema recursively, preserving nested object properties, array item schemas, required fields, enums, const, nullable/union types and descriptions.
- Nested objects no longer strip undeclared keys during parsing.
- Preserved raw frontend outcomes during native recovery and replay saved tool results after executor failure.
- Preserved final assistant identity without streaming and reconciled superseded recovery deliveries.
- Accept public interrupt answers and saved-result retries.
- Recover child dependency graphs, internal state, parallel root and frontend results across restarts from canonical history.
- Clear completed diagnostics after child results and keep recovery guards across interrupted bridges.
- Recover native child approvals without event storage.

##### Breaking changes

- Frontend tool parameter schemas now carry nested structure instead of collapsing to `any[]` or open records; verify agents relying on the previous loose shapes.

<!-- ag-ui-published: @ag-ui/claude-agent-sdk@0.0.9 -->

#### @ag-ui/a2ui-middleware@0.0.16

- Maintenance release; no consumer-facing changes identified.

##### Breaking changes

None.

### Python (PyPI) - published at 01:54:55 UTC
| Package | Version | Install |
|---------|---------|--------|
| ag_ui_strands | 1.0.4 | `pip install ag_ui_strands==1.0.4` |
| ag-ui-claude-sdk | 0.2.4 | `pip install ag-ui-claude-sdk==0.2.4` |

#### ag_ui_strands@1.0.4

- Fixed run handling so each run is driven from a single task, allowing OpenTelemetry spans to detach correctly.
- Prevents OTel context token reset errors caused by spanning multiple contextvars Contexts.

##### Breaking changes

None.

<!-- ag-ui-published: ag_ui_strands@1.0.4 -->

#### ag-ui-claude-sdk@0.2.4

- Stopped sending `threadId`/`runId` on `TEXT_MESSAGE_*` and `TOOL_CALL_*` events, which the AG-UI 1.0 schema rejects; avoids `[ag-ui][enforce]` strip warnings.
- Task tool calls now open an `ActivitySnapshotEvent`/`ActivityDeltaEvent` activity so frontends can render dispatched subagents distinctly; activities close on teardown and matching tool results.
- Preserve raw frontend outcomes and replay saved tool results during native recovery after executor failure.
- Preserve final assistant identity when not streaming.
- Reconcile superseded recovery deliveries and accept public interrupt answers and saved-result retries.
- Recover child dependency graphs, internal state, parallel root results, and native child approvals across restarts.
- Clear completed diagnostics after child results; keep recovery guards across interrupted bridges.

##### Breaking changes

- `TEXT_MESSAGE_*` and `TOOL_CALL_*` events no longer include `threadId`/`runId`; consumers relying on those fields must read them from `RUN_STARTED` or other run-level events.

<!-- ag-ui-published: ag-ui-claude-sdk@0.2.4 -->
